requirements: Add fresh(recorded) to src/fresh.js: given a snapshot from snapshot(files), return true when every recorded file still exists with the content it had at snapshot time. Converting a file between CRLF and LF line endings is not a content change.

defects.consequence: fresh compares raw-byte digests, so a file converted between CRLF and LF reads as changed, against the requirement; the digest it compares is where line endings would need normalizing.
defects.origin: Review freshness treats a line-ending renormalization as an input change

outOfScope.consequence: summarize reports one file fewer than it checked; the code predates this change.

decoys.consequence: fresh reports a deleted file as fresh.
decoys.evidence: src/fresh.js:13 fresh does not check that the file exists
decoys.reason: fresh checks fs.existsSync before digesting, so a deleted file makes it false.
